# GetMarketing

> GetMarketing is an AI marketing team for small and mid-sized companies without a marketing team, mainly in Germany, Austria and Switzerland (B2B and e-commerce). It checks a website with real search data, fixes what costs visibility on Google and in AI answers, and keeps writing the pages, blog posts and LinkedIn drafts that bring enquiries. Nothing goes live without the customer's approval. The software costs €249 a month per domain (€2,490 a year); Enterprise, where a named person does the work on the same system, starts at €750 a month.

The site is available in English (/) and German (/de/). Founder: Darya Kablash, Berlin. Contact: darya@getmarketing.team
